Bill.BriefDescription: Limiting the scope of the department of transportation's administration of the state's ferry system.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to limiting the scope of the department oftransportation's administration of the state's ferry system; adding anew section to chapter 47.60 RCW; creating a new section; and providingan effective date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature recognizes that thecontinuing operation and maintenance of the state ferry system is anintegral part of Washington's economy. The legislature recognizesfurther that the department of transportation has dedicated substantialfunds to designing, redesigning, constructing, and improving ferriesand ferry facilities. In order to provide for the continuing viabilityof the ferry system, the legislature intends to limit the scope of thedepartment's responsibilities and powers with regard to the ferrysystem to only the maintenance and operation of ferries and ferryfacilities and the acquisition of new ferries or ferry facilities whendirected by the legislature.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 47.60 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Beginning January 1, 2015, the department may not design,construct, or make substantial alterations to ferries or ferryfacilities unless so directed by the legislature. For the purposes ofthis subsection, "substantial alterations" means any project that isanticipated to cost more than twentyfive percent of the fair marketvalue of the ferry or ferry facility to be altered at the time of thealteration. (2) This section does not limit the department's power to purchaseor otherwise acquire ferries or ferry facilities.
